title: No One Left

facts.claim: Current Housing Vacancy Survey definitions distinguish occupied units by usual-residence status and permit an entirely occupied unit to be classified vacant when the occupants' usual residence is elsewhere.
facts.source_selector: turn473893view0 official Census PDF lines 95-108 and 141-148; turn140448view0 page-3 screenshot
facts.draft_exact_string: Current Census Housing Vacancy Survey definitions say that an occupied unit's residents must consider it their usual residence or have no usual residence elsewhere, while a unit may be classified vacant when it is entirely occupied by people whose usual residence is elsewhere.

facts.claim: SQLite's current WAL documentation places runtime 3.46.1 in the likely affected range for a rare race requiring multiple connections and concurrent write/checkpoint activity; the D004 receipt records a one-connection profile that does not exercise that trigger.
facts.source_selector: turn515699view0 official SQLite WAL documentation lines 195-218 plus poems/P0003/artifact/d004/WAL_RECEIPT.json execution_profile
facts.draft_exact_string: The packaged Python runtime reports SQLite 3.46.1, a version within SQLite's documented WAL-reset-bug range. The build used one database connection, no concurrent writer, disabled automatic checkpointing, and no checkpoint during the committed transition, so it did not exercise the documented multi-connection write/checkpoint trigger.
